lines.gurmukhi: ਗੋਰਾਂ ਸੇ ਨਿਮਾਣੀਆ ਬਹਸਨਿ ਰੂਹਾਂ ਮਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: goraa(n) se nimaaneeaa bahasan roohaa(n) mal ||
lines.translation: They remain there, in those unhonored graves.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਖੀਂ ਸੇਖਾ ਬੰਦਗੀ ਚਲਣੁ ਅਜੁ ਕਿ ਕਲਿ ॥੯੭॥
lines.transliteration: aakhee(n) sekhaa ba(n)dagee chalan aj k kal ||97||
lines.translation: O Shaykh, dedicate yourself to God; you will have to depart, today or tomorrow. ||97||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਮਉਤੈ ਦਾ ਬੰਨਾ ਏਵੈ ਦਿਸੈ ਜਿਉ ਦਰੀਆਵੈ ਢਾਹਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa mautai daa ba(n)naa evai disai jiu dareeaavai dhaahaa ||
lines.translation: Fareed, the shore of death looks like the river-bank, being eroded away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗੈ ਦੋਜਕੁ ਤਪਿਆ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਹੂਲ ਪਵੈ ਕਾਹਾਹਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: agai dojak tapiaa suneeai hool pavai kaahaahaa ||
lines.translation: Beyond is the burning hell, from which cries and shrieks are heard.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਨਾ ਨੋ ਸਭ ਸੋਝੀ ਆਈ ਇਕਿ ਫਿਰਦੇ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikanaa no sabh sojhee aaee ik phirade veparavaahaa ||
lines.translation: Some understand this completely, while others wander around carelessly.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਮਲ ਜਿ ਕੀਤਿਆ ਦੁਨੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੇ ਦਰਗਹ ਓਗਾਹਾ ॥੯੮॥
lines.transliteration: amal j keetiaa dunee vich se daragah ogaahaa ||98||
lines.translation: Those actions which are done in this world, shall be examined in the Court of the Lord. ||98||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਦਰੀਆਵੈ ਕੰਨੑੈ ਬਗੁਲਾ ਬੈਠਾ ਕੇਲ ਕਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa dareeaavai ka(n)nhai bagulaa baithaa kel kare ||
lines.translation: Fareed, the crane perches on the river bank, playing joyfully.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੇਲ ਕਰੇਦੇ ਹੰਝ ਨੋ ਅਚਿੰਤੇ ਬਾਜ ਪਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: kel karede ha(n)jh no achi(n)te baaj pae ||
lines.translation: While it is playing, a hawk suddenly pounces on it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਜ ਪਏ ਤਿਸੁ ਰਬ ਦੇ ਕੇਲਾਂ ਵਿਸਰੀਆਂ ॥
lines.transliteration: baaj pae tis rab de kelaa(n) visareeaa(n) ||
lines.translation: When the Hawk of God attacks, playful sport is forgotten.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਚੇਤੇ ਸਨਿ ਸੋ ਗਾਲੀ ਰਬ ਕੀਆਂ ॥੯੯॥
lines.transliteration: jo man chit na chete san so gaalee rab keeaa(n) ||99||
lines.translation: God does what is not expected or even considered. ||99||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਢੇ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਮਣ ਦੇਹੁਰੀ ਚਲੈ ਪਾਣੀ ਅੰਨਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadhe trai man dehuree chalai paanee a(n)n ||
lines.translation: The body is nourished by water and grain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਇਓ ਬੰਦਾ ਦੁਨੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਤਿ ਆਸੂਣੀ ਬੰਨੑਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: aaio ba(n)daa dunee vich vat aasoonee ba(n)nhi ||
lines.translation: The mortal comes into the world with high hopes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਲਕਲ ਮਉਤ ਜਾਂ ਆਵਸੀ ਸਭ ਦਰਵਾਜੇ ਭੰਨਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: malakal maut jaa(n) aavasee sabh daravaaje bha(n)n ||
lines.translation: But when the Messenger of Death comes, it breaks down all the doors.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨੑਾ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਭਾਈਆਂ ਅਗੈ ਦਿਤਾ ਬੰਨੑਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: tinhaa piaariaa bhaaeeaa(n) agai ditaa ba(n)nhi ||
lines.translation: It binds and gags the mortal, before the eyes of his beloved brothers.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵੇਖਹੁ ਬੰਦਾ ਚਲਿਆ ਚਹੁ ਜਣਿਆ ਦੈ ਕੰਨੑਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: vekhahu ba(n)daa chaliaa chahu janiaa dai ka(n)nhi ||
lines.translation: Behold, the mortal being is going away, carried on the shoulders of four men.

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਅਮਲ ਜਿ ਕੀਤੇ ਦੁਨੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਆਏ ਕੰਮਿ ॥੧੦੦॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa amal j keete dunee vich daragah aae ka(n)m ||100||
lines.translation: Fareed, only those good deeds done in the world will be of any use in the Court of the Lord. ||100||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਿਨੑ ਪੰਖੀਆ ਜੰਗਲਿ ਜਿੰਨੑਾ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa hau balihaaree tinh pa(n)kheeaa ja(n)gal ji(n)nhaa vaas ||
lines.translation: Fareed, I am a sacrifice to those birds which live in the jungle.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਕਰੁ ਚੁਗਨਿ ਥਲਿ ਵਸਨਿ ਰਬ ਨ ਛੋਡਨਿ ਪਾਸੁ ॥੧੦੧॥
lines.transliteration: kakar chugan thal vasan rab na chhodan paas ||101||
lines.translation: They peck at the roots and live on the ground, but they do not leave the Lord's side. ||101||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਰੁਤਿ ਫਿਰੀ ਵਣੁ ਕੰਬਿਆ ਪਤ ਝੜੇ ਝੜਿ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa rut phiree van ka(n)biaa pat jhaRe jhaR paahi ||
lines.translation: Fareed, the seasons change, the woods shake and the leaves drop from the trees.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਡਾ ਢੂੰਢੀਆਂ ਰਹਣੁ ਕਿਥਾਊ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੧੦੨॥
lines.transliteration: chaare ku(n)daa dhoo(n)dheeaa(n) rahan kithaaoo naahi ||102||
lines.translation: I have searched in the four directions, but I have not found any resting place anywhere. ||102||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਪਾੜਿ ਪਟੋਲਾ ਧਜ ਕਰੀ ਕੰਬਲੜੀ ਪਹਿਰੇਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa paaR patolaa dhaj karee ka(n)balaRee pahireu ||
lines.translation: Fareed, I have torn my clothes to tatters; now I wear only a rough blanket.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑੀ ਵੇਸੀ ਸਹੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੇਈ ਵੇਸ ਕਰੇਉ ॥੧੦੩॥
lines.transliteration: jinhee vesee sahu milai seee ves kareu ||103||
lines.translation: I wear only those clothes which will lead me to meet my Lord. ||103||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਇ ਪਟੋਲਾ ਪਾੜਤੀ ਕੰਬਲੜੀ ਪਹਿਰੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaai patolaa paaRatee ka(n)balaRee pahirei ||
lines.translation: Why do you tear apart your fine clothes, and take to wearing a rough blanket?

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਬੈਠਿਆ ਸਹੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਜੇ ਨੀਅਤਿ ਰਾਸਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੧੦੪॥
lines.transliteration: naanak ghar hee baithiaa sahu milai je neeat raas karei ||104||
lines.translation: O Nanak, even sitting in your own home, you can meet the Lord, if your mind is in the right place. ||104||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਗਰਬੁ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਧਨਿ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਆਗਾਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa garab jinhaa vadiaaeeaa dhan joban aagaah ||
lines.translation: Fareed, those who are very proud of their greatness, wealth and youth,

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਾਲੀ ਚਲੇ ਧਣੀ ਸਿਉ ਟਿਬੇ ਜਿਉ ਮੀਹਾਹੁ ॥੧੦੫॥
lines.transliteration: khaalee chale dhanee siu tibe jiu meehaahu ||105||
lines.translation: shall return empty-handed from their Lord, like sandhills after the rain. ||105||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਤਿਨਾ ਮੁਖ ਡਰਾਵਣੇ ਜਿਨਾ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਓਨੁ ਨਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa tinaa mukh daraavane jinaa visaarion naau ||
lines.translation: Fareed, the faces of those who forget the Lord's Name are dreadful.

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਥੈ ਦੁਖ ਘਣੇਰਿਆ ਅਗੈ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਠਾਉ ॥੧੦੬॥
lines.transliteration: aithai dukh ghaneriaa agai thaur na thaau ||106||
lines.translation: They suffer terrible pain here, and hereafter they find no place of rest or refuge. ||106||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਪਿਛਲ ਰਾਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਗਿਓਹਿ ਜੀਵਦੜੋ ਮੁਇਓਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa pichhal raat na jaagiohi jeevadaRo muiohi ||
lines.translation: Fareed, if you do not awaken in the early hours before dawn, you are dead while yet alive.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਤੈ ਰਬੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਤ ਰਬਿ ਨ ਵਿਸਰਿਓਹਿ ॥੧੦੭॥
lines.transliteration: je tai rab visaariaa ta rab na visariohi ||107||
lines.translation: Although you have forgotten God, God has not forgotten you. ||107||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਕੰਤੁ ਰੰਗਾਵਲਾ ਵਡਾ ਵੇਮੁਹਤਾਜੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa ka(n)t ra(n)gaavalaa vadaa vemuhataaj ||
lines.translation: Fareed, my Husband Lord is full of joy; He is Great and Self-sufficient.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਲਹ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ ਏਹੁ ਸਚਾਵਾਂ ਸਾਜੁ ॥੧੦੮॥
lines.transliteration: alah setee ratiaa ehu sachaavaa(n) saaj ||108||
lines.translation: To be imbued with the Lord God - this is the most beautiful decoration. ||108||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਇਕੁ ਕਰਿ ਦਿਲ ਤੇ ਲਾਹਿ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa dukh sukh ik kar dil te laahi vikaar ||
lines.translation: Fareed, look upon pleasure and pain as the same; eradicate corruption from your heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਲਹ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਭਲਾ ਤਾਂ ਲਭੀ ਦਰਬਾਰੁ ॥੧੦੯॥
lines.transliteration: alah bhaavai so bhalaa taa(n) labhee darabaar ||109||
lines.translation: Whatever pleases the Lord God is good; understand this, and you will reach His Court. ||109||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਦੁਨੀ ਵਜਾਈ ਵਜਦੀ ਤੂੰ ਭੀ ਵਜਹਿ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa dunee vajaaee vajadee too(n) bhee vajahi naal ||
lines.translation: Fareed, the world dances as it dances, and you dance with it as well.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਜੀਉ ਨ ਵਜਦਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਅਲਹੁ ਕਰਦਾ ਸਾਰ ॥੧੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: soee jeeu na vajadaa jis alahu karadaa saar ||110||
lines.translation: That soul alone does not dance with it, who is under the care of the Lord God. ||110||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਦਿਲੁ ਰਤਾ ਇਸੁ ਦੁਨੀ ਸਿਉ ਦੁਨੀ ਨ ਕਿਤੈ ਕੰਮਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa dil rataa is dunee siu dunee na kitai ka(n)m ||
lines.translation: Fareed, the heart is imbued with this world, but the world is of no use to it at all.
